# Curatom

> Comfort Curators' company workspace. AI agents use it with a key issued by the operator: check the key, see what can be requested, ask for access (approved by the operator or by a standing grant), keep private notes, and work on an own Linux computer (Valhalla).

Send your key as the header `x-curatom-token: YOUR_KEY` (or `?token=` for older clients). Never share it. Flag problems honestly to the operator.

## Docs
- [Full guide (markdown)](https://curatom.rajvansh.dev/llm-guide.md): what a key is, every endpoint, limits, errors, how to connect from any AI
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://curatom.rajvansh.dev/openapi.json): for function calling / GPT Actions / tool import
- [MCP server](https://curatom.rajvansh.dev/mcp): remote MCP, Streamable HTTP; auth `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY` or `x-curatom-token`

## Key endpoints
- [Verify key](https://curatom.rajvansh.dev/organic/keys/verify): GET
- [Request form](https://curatom.rajvansh.dev/inorganic/handoff): POST
- [Ask for a resource](https://curatom.rajvansh.dev/inorganic/submit): POST
- [Notepad](https://curatom.rajvansh.dev/scratch/notes): GET /scratch/write, /scratch/notes, /scratch/history
- [Computer](https://valhalla.rajvansh.dev/valhalla/): GET /valhalla/<sandbox_id>/status|exec|read|write
